_about: Authored. Maps FactSet metric codes to the shared finance model. 'field' is a mockfin metric used for ANN/QTR values; 'expr' is an arithmetic formula over mockfin metrics (used when there's no field, and for LTM). 'kind' is flow (summed for LTM) or stock (period-end). Properties for codes seen live are in metrics_catalog_observed.json and take precedence.

properties.description: Net Sales or Revenues represents gross sales and other operating revenue less discounts, returns and allowances. It is the top line of the income statement and the base for margin and growth analysis.
properties.name: Net Sales or Revenues

properties.description: Cost of Goods Sold excluding depreciation represents the direct costs attributable to producing the goods or services sold during the period.
properties.name: Cost of Goods Sold

properties.description: Operating Income represents revenue less cost of goods sold, selling, general and administrative expense, research and development and depreciation. It measures profit from core operations before interest and taxes.
properties.name: Operating Income

properties.description: EBITDA (Operating) is operating income plus depreciation and amortization. It approximates cash operating profit and is the usual denominator for EV/EBITDA.
properties.name: EBITDA (Operating)

properties.description: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization represents the non-cash allocation of the cost of tangible and intangible assets over their useful lives.
properties.name: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization

properties.description: Net Income represents income after all operating and non-operating income and expenses, reserves, income taxes, minority interest and extraordinary items, as reported.
properties.name: Net Income

properties.description: Net Margin is reported net income as a percentage of net sales or revenues. It shows how much of each unit of revenue becomes profit for shareholders.
properties.name: Net Margin

properties.description: Diluted Earnings per Share is reported net income divided by diluted weighted average shares outstanding.
properties.name: EPS - Diluted

properties.description: Dividends per Share represents the total dividends declared per common share during the period.
properties.name: Dividends per Share

properties.description: Diluted weighted average common shares outstanding used to compute diluted EPS, in millions.
properties.name: Shares Outstanding - Diluted

properties.description: Cash and Short Term Investments represents cash on hand, deposits and marketable securities readily convertible to cash.
properties.name: Cash and Short Term Investments

properties.description: Total Debt represents all interest-bearing and capitalized lease obligations, short and long term.
properties.name: Total Debt

properties.description: Net Debt is total debt less cash and short term investments. A negative value indicates a net cash position.
properties.name: Net Debt

properties.description: Common Equity represents common shareholders' investment in the company, including retained earnings.
properties.name: Common Equity

properties.description: Total Assets represents the sum of current and long term assets owned by the company.
properties.name: Total Assets

properties.description: Book Value per Share is common equity divided by shares outstanding.
properties.name: Book Value per Share

properties.description: Return on Average Common Equity is reported net income as a percentage of average common equity. It measures profitability relative to shareholder capital.
properties.name: Return on Average Common Equity

properties.description: Return on Average Assets is reported net income as a percentage of average total assets.
properties.name: Return on Average Assets

properties.description: Capital Expenditures represents funds used to acquire or upgrade fixed assets such as property, plant and equipment.
properties.name: Capital Expenditures

properties.description: Net Operating Cash Flow represents cash generated by operating activities after working capital changes.
properties.name: Net Operating Cash Flow

properties.description: Free Cash Flow is net operating cash flow less capital expenditures. It is the cash available to providers of capital.
properties.name: Free Cash Flow

properties.description: Total Debt to Common Equity is total debt as a percentage of common equity. It measures financial leverage.
properties.name: Total Debt to Common Equity

properties.description: Net Debt to EBITDA is net debt divided by operating EBITDA, a common credit leverage multiple.
properties.name: Net Debt to EBITDA

properties.description: Free Cash Flow Margin is free cash flow as a percentage of net sales or revenues.
properties.name: Free Cash Flow Margin

properties.description: Consensus earnings per share on the broker-preferred (typically adjusted, diluted) basis.
properties.name: Earnings Per Share

properties.description: Consensus net sales or revenues, in millions of the estimate currency.
properties.name: Sales

properties.description: Consensus earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization, in millions.
properties.name: EBITDA

properties.description: Consensus earnings before interest and taxes (operating income), in millions.
properties.name: EBIT

properties.description: Consensus net income on the broker-preferred basis, in millions.
properties.name: Net Income

properties.description: Consensus gross margin as a percentage of sales.
properties.name: Gross Margin

properties.description: Consensus dividends per share.
properties.name: Dividends Per Share

properties.description: Consensus capital expenditure, in millions.
properties.name: Capital Expenditure

properties.description: Consensus cash flow from operations, in millions.
properties.name: Cash Flow From Operations

properties.description: Consensus free cash flow, in millions.
properties.name: Free Cash Flow

properties.description: Consensus net debt at fiscal period end, in millions.
properties.name: Net Debt

properties.description: Consensus return on equity, percent.
properties.name: Return on Equity
